text:
Type: drawer unit with five drawers
Use: storing papers, stationery and office supplies, beside or under a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white painted board, smooth matte finish
Colors: bright white
Shape: tall narrow box, five stacked flush drawers in graded heights, curved cut-out finger pulls, flat top, small feet, compact and clean
Feel: bright, tidy, calm, functional
Goes with: white or light wood desktops, black or pastel accents; Scandinavian or minimalist home offices and bedrooms

product.name: ALEX
product.description: Drawer stops prevent the drawers from being pulled out too far.
